## Rule

ARC-GEN `task_2204b7a8.py`: fixed 10x10 grids. The input has two opposite full border strips in two non-green colors plus green (3) probe cells in the interior. The generator may transpose the grid, so the borders are either left/right columns or top/bottom rows. Output keeps all non-green cells and recolors each green probe by the nearest/opposite border half: top/left half -> color0 at corner (0,0), bottom/right half -> color1 at corner (9,9).

## Algorithm sketch

```python
idx = arg_color(input[:10, :10])
color0 = idx[0, 0]
color1 = idx[9, 9]
col_axis = idx[0, 0] == idx[9, 0]  # true for left/right borders
row_repl = where(row < 5, color0, color1)
col_repl = where(col < 5, color0, color1)
repl = where(col_axis, col_repl, row_repl)
idx = where(idx == 3, repl, idx)
output = one_hot(pad_to_30(idx, sentinel=10))
```

## FLOOR PROOF (362 — free-output Einsum, w13 beta_p29_claude_cli 2026-06-24)

Graph = 5 nodes: 3 MaxPool corner reads (kernel [1,1], minimal) + 1 Concat (`color_rows`) + 1 free F32 Einsum `bihw,mi,qh,rw,tgq,ugr,poxy,mgp,zkuv,akrs,tua->bohw`. Cost 362 = memory 240 + params 122. Every prompt-named lever priced and rejected:

| lever (prompt direction) | verdict | reason |
|---|---|---|
| smaller MaxPool kernel | n/a | already kernel [1,1]; cannot shrink |
| cheaper nearest-half via ArgMin/TopK | LOSE | the nearest-half select is ALREADY folded into the free Einsum (`halves`×`term_basis`); a separate ArgMin/TopK ADDS ops + an INT64/F32 intermediate, never cheaper than free-output |
| shrink `halves` [2,30]=60 (dominant param) | LOSE | prior `generated_second_half`→814 (generate/Pad of the 30-wide complement materializes ≥240B memory; output IS 30-wide so basis can't be [2,10]) |
| remove `color_rows` Concat [3,10,1,1]=120B (dominant mem) | FORCED | the 3-row stack is contracted at TWO independent index positions (`p` in `poxy`/color_coeff AND `a` in `akrs`/orient_pair). A single static Einsum needs the rows on a shared sum axis = the Concat. Pre-contracting either role (`einsum('akrs,tua->tukrs')` etc.) materializes intermediates >120B; splitting into a sum-of-3-Einsums adds nodes + temps. Confirmed numpy-equivalent to ORT. |
| drop `zero_color` from the stack → [2,10,1,1]=80B | LOSE | `orient_pair[:,:,0]`=0 (a-role doesn't need zero_color) BUT `color_coeff[:,:,0]`≠0 (p-role DOES). Both roles share one tensor, so the p-role forces all 3 rows. |
| corner reads [1,10,1,1]=40B ×3 | FORCED | 10-channel = color identity (mandatory). Merging 3 pools into one stride read yields 4 corners = 160B > 120B. |
| params `input_modes`/`color_coeff`/`orient_pair`/`term_basis` | minimal | input_modes needs all 10 input channels; coeff tensors carry the 3-row + 2-orient indices. |

**Verdict: 362 is the floor for the free-output Einsum family.** memory 240 (color_rows 120 + 3 corners 120) and params 122 (halves 60 + rest) are each individually irreducible. No staged candidate this session; 362 (`staged_submits/task040_maxpool_sharedbasis_cost362/`) stands. Gates already passing (recorded above, candidate unchanged — not re-run on identical artifact).

2026-06-08 colorcanvas rewrite (cost 1785 = memory 1724 + params 61, points 17.512826): replaces the live F16 mask/paint assembly (current live cost 16648) with scalar U8 color-index logic. Main charged tensors are `ci30` Pad UINT8 [1,1,30,30] = 900B, `idx_f32` Conv F32 [1,1,10,10] = 400B, and four 10x10 U8/BOOL planes (`idx_u8`, `repl`, `is_probe`, `ci10`) = 400B. The remaining shaped scalars and 10-vectors account for the rest.

The reliable lower-bound shape is the Equal-tail color-canvas pattern: padding the scalar color canvas costs 900B, while padding a 10-channel one-hot active output would charge 1000B before the final output. The Conv crop+color-index collapse is the cheapest ship-safe way found to read the one-hot F32 input without materializing a 10-channel crop.
